behaviours.name: Ancient Curse (instant Shadow damage at reference spell power)
behaviours.observe_source: Spell.dbc 500712 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (SchoolMask 32 Shadow), EffectBasePoints 975, EffectDieSides 60, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 1.25, BaseLevel 59, SpellLevel 59, MaxLevel 0 (no SkillLineAbility row). At level 60, per-level points = (60 - 59) * 1.25 = 1.25 (truncated to 1 in SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue), so raw roll at SP 0 is 975 + 1 + [1..60] = [977..1036]. Cultist class tuning aura 887013 (AscensionClassTuning.h:34; Spell.dbc BaseLevel 10, MaxLevel 60, Effect[0] aura 341 bp -1 + die 1 + int(50 * 0.25) = +12% all schools) multiplies every hit by 1.12 (floor(hit * 112 / 100)): [1094..1160]. Precondition fixtures: 823764 (beeg spellpen, removes partial resists) and 16255 amount -100 (removes crits). Control is the uncast before read (0). Paired with instant_sp (+20000 SP) in the same counted pair. Reference search 2026-11-24: coabuildhub spells_master_index.json entry 500712 is an older patch state (SP*1); installed Spell.dbc governs (G-9); ~/Projects/coa-log-history/coa-history not present.

attempt_auras.source: caster aura 823764 (target resistance -9999 on magic schools): prevents full resists on Darkwither 502220 periodic Shadow ticks so every tick deals damage and enters the proc check (precondition fixture; test-only aura with no player cast)

clears Insanity 500706 before each Darkwither 502220 cast (AscensionCustomResourceData.h:282 grants 10 Insanity per cast) so Insanity stays at 0->10 and never reaches 100 to trigger Insane 803060 (+30% spell haste) (precondition fixture)

isolation.source: Darkwither 502220 has single-target EffectImplicitTargetA 6 with EffectRadiusIndex 0 and EffectChainTarget 0 on all three effects (including triggered Withered 706913 aura 259, EffectImplicitTargetA 6, EffectRadiusIndex 0) and is cast at the stream's own dummy by id at dummy_distance 10 yd (outside 5 yd melee range, inside 30 yd RangeIndex 4); 823764 and Insanity 500706 are caster-only auras; Mind Rot 560943 has EffectImplicitTargetA 6, EffectRadiusIndex 0; aura_ascension_cultist_event only accepts the caster's own outgoing damage (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:71,82,165); streams are ungrouped.

behaviours.observe_source: Mind Rot 300300 (passive, Attributes 0x1c0; Effect[1] aura 42 EffectTriggerSpell 560943, ProcChance 25 = $h; spell_proc Chance 100, Cooldown 0; spell_script_names aura_ascension_cultist_event): AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:82 checks dealt && (periodic || (info && info->IsChanneled())) && Chance(player, id) (which rolls Spell.dbc ProcChance 25% directly via roll_chance_f, ignoring spell mods so forced_roll cannot force it) and :165 calls Cast(player, target, 560943), counted by spell_cast_count of 560943. Trigger: Darkwither 502220 (instant, GCD 1500 ms, 17% of 1512 BaseMana = 257 mana, cast_power 2000 <= 2297 MaxMana; Duration 15000 ms, Effect[0] aura 3 periodic Shadow damage, EffectAmplitude 3000 ms, no START_PERIODIC_AT_APPLY -> 5 ticks per cast inside 15500 ms). Unlearned control: 2 cycles x 5 ticks x 5 parts x 8 streams = 400 trials (>= 50), expects 0 procs. Treatment: 93 cycles x 5 ticks x 5 parts x 8 streams = 18600 trials (>= 18576 flip-proof trials for 25% with G-19 +-2 pt band over 5 parts, residual edge-crossing failure <= 0.1% per pair). Reference search 2026-11-24: coabuildhub spells_master_index.json entry 300300 matches verbatim ('25% chance to curse your target, applying Mind Rot'); ~/Projects/coa-log-history/coa-history not present.
